pages.name: Tejler Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4 onto the square Black's queen occupies and called the f-file open. Rewrote it around O-O-O on the open d-file and the half-open f-file. British spelling.

pages.name: Trompowsky: 2...d5 3.Bxf6 exf6 4.e3 c6
pages.notes: Overview called the e-file open (White's e3-pawn makes it half-open); plan 1 gave a g4-h4 storm; plan 2 used a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Rapport-Jobava System, with e6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named e5 as a bare square to control; plan 3 had an ...h6-g5 pawn route. Rewrote both around Nb5, ...Bd6 and ...Nf6-h5. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov Attack: Two Knights System
pages.notes: Plan 3 gave ...g5 with White's bishop on g5. Rewrote it around ...h6 and ...c5. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov Attack: Two Knights System, Grünfeld Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 said Bxf6 inflicts a pawn weakness, though the d7-knight recaptures; plan 4 gave ...g5 with White's bishop on g5. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov Attack: Veresov Variation
pages.notes: Overview called the g5-bishop light-squared and gave Black an open g-file before any recapture; plan 1 targeted queenside pawns that are not weak; plan 3 had light-square control via Ne2-g3-e5, a dark square. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov: 3...Bf5 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Re1 with White uncastled. Rewrote it around e3 and Bd3. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov: 3...h6
pages.notes: Plan 1 called e5 a light square and used a g-file White does not have; plan 2 wrote exf6 before any bishop is on f6; plan 3 kept a pin that does not exist; plan 4 gave ...g5 with the bishop on g5. Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov: 3...Nbd7 4.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 called the g5-bishop light-squared and said Bxf6 leaves weaknesses, though the d7-knight recaptures; plan 4 wrote ...0-0. Rewrote both. British spelling.

pages.name: Richter-Veresov: 3...Ne4
pages.notes: Both plans called the e4-knight a pawn. Rewrote both (first plan 2 rewrite rejected for ...Nxg5 and ...h6 ideas that do not hold after 4.Bf4; corrected and accepted). British spelling.
